## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] `ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `pytest`
- [ ] Documentation updated where behavior or configuration changed

## Privacy and release safety

- [ ] I used only synthetic or consented fixtures.
- [ ] I did not add credentials, webhooks, demos, voices, databases, logs,
      browser profiles, local paths, or real player identifiers.
- [ ] I reviewed consent, retention, disk, and network implications.
- [ ] New dependencies and downloaded binaries have compatible licenses.
